Fruit feeder

Place a two-port feeder on the marked front edge, then fill it. Hungry macaws walk to a bowl and eat real portions. Hunger runs from 0% (full) to 100% (very hungry). Refill service has the displayed Zoo Coin cost.

Fill feeder · 8 ZC Remove feeder

Build 80 ZC · Refill service 8 ZC · Balance 1,210 ZC. Removal returns only actual construction spending; refill fees are not refunded.

Food: 4/8 portions (macaw 1: 2; macaw 2: 2). Consumption happens only when a bird finishes eating.

Fresh water

Place two blue water bowls at the sides of the aviary, then refill them. Thirsty macaws approach and drink real portions. Thirst runs from 0% (hydrated) to 100% (very thirsty). Refill service has the displayed Zoo Coin cost.

Refill water · 4 ZC Remove water bowls

Build 60 ZC · Refill service 4 ZC · Balance 1,210 ZC. Removal returns only actual construction spending; refill fees are not refunded.

Water: 4/8 portions (macaw 1: 2; macaw 2: 2). Stock decreases only when a bird finishes drinking.

Rest & enrichment

Prepare two supported leafy perches. Tired macaws sleep to recover energy; awake macaws look around the plants to improve enrichment. Both scores run from 0% to 100% (higher is better). Benefits happen only while the bird uses a prepared perch. Food and water still need care. Construction has the displayed Zoo Coin cost.

Remove rest garden

Build 80 ZC · Balance 1,210 ZC. Removal returns actual construction spending.

Prepared perches: resting 0/2; exploring 0/2. Energy rises only during sleep; enrichment rises only during exploration. Urgent food/water can interrupt safely.
